attrs.evidence: INV-R9 recorded the relation as a `why` paragraph and checked only that the named canonical claim existed, so GPT-5.6 remapped the single live record from FAC-RECEIPT-EVIDENCE-CLOSED to the unrelated settled FED-Q2-D3-WITNESS at exit 0 — the same species as INV-R5.1 (`reference exists ≠ reference is relevant`) and INV-R5.2 (`evidence resolves ≠ evidence eliminates this doubt`). INV-R9.2 gives the disposition a typed `relation` and an `argument_ref`, adds the argument role `proposition_subsumption`, and refuses a disposition whose argument does not conclude exactly that relation over exactly that pair — MUT-INTEGRATION-SUBSUMPTION-IRRELEVANT. MEASURED: 1 of 1 relation DECLARED, 0 of 1 DISCHARGED. INV-R7.4 ruled the ladder for impact narrowings — no knowledge ⇒ ⊤, declared ⇒ STILL ⊤, declared and discharged ⇒ apply — and this is the same object one layer up, so the gate prints the fraction rather than treating the argument as settling the matter.
attrs.gap: DISCHARGING IT IS THE DEFINITIONAL-SUBSUMPTION PROBLEM THIS LEDGER ALREADY DECLINED TO MECHANISE AT INV-R6. Both propositions are prose about a mechanism, not formulae, so the entailment is read by a person and the reading is what would have to be discharged. What is NOT open is whether the disposition is well-formed: it names a typed relation, an argument, and a pair, and a remapping is refused. What is open is whether the relation holds.
attrs.prior_art: GPT-5.6’s INV-R9 audit §6 asked for the typed relation and the argument ref. Modular assurance cases have the same object: GSN’s away goals reference a claim defined in another module, and the GSN Community Standard binds them through a CONTRACT module rather than through a note — the connections are the contract’s assumptions. `already_present` is an away-goal binding, and INV-R9 wrote the note.
attrs.review_focus: Is `declared but not discharged` the right resting place, or should an undischarged subsumption force the candidate into needs_adjudication and BLOCK the promotion? The conservative reading of INV-R7.4’s ladder says the second, and this round did not take it.
attrs.statement: A candidate disposed of as `already_present` requires a DISCHARGED subsumption: an argument establishing that the named canonical proposition is equivalent to, or strictly broader than, the source proposition. Declaring the relation is not discharging it.
